#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(0);
    }

    struct Scanner {
        Scanner(InputStream& in) : in(in) {}
        InputStream& in;
        int k = 0, l = 0;
        vector<char> bb(1 << 15);

        char getc() {
            if (k >= l) {
                k = 0;
                l = in.read(bb.data(), bb.size());
                if (l <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return bb[k++];
        }

        int nextInt() {
            char c = 0;
            while (c <= 32) c = getc();
            int a = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                a = a * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = getc();
            }
            return a;
        }
    };

    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> aa_;
    int n_, m_;
    vector<int> pi, dd, bb;
    vector<int> uu, vv, uv, cost;
    vector<int> cc;
    vector<int> qq;
    int nq = 1, head, cnt;
    vector<bool> iq;

    void init(int n, int m, int k) {
        aa_.resize(n);
        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++)
            aa_[u].clear();
        pi.assign(n, INF);
        dd.assign(n, 0);
        bb.assign(n, 0);
        nq = max(n, 1);
        qq.resize(nq);
        iq.assign(n, false);
        uu.resize(m);
        vv.resize(m);
        uv.resize(m);
        cost.resize(m);
        cc.resize(m * 2);
        m_ = 0;
    }

    void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_++;
        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cc[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap;
        aa_[u].push_back(h << 1 ^ 0);
        aa_[v].push_back(h << 1 ^ 1);
    }

    void enqueue(int v) {
        if (iq[v])
            return;
        if (head + cnt == nq) {
            if (cnt * 2 <= nq) {
                for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++)
                    qq[i] = qq[head + i];
            } else {
                vector<int> qq_(nq *= 2);
                for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++)
                    qq_[i] = qq[head + i];
                qq = move(qq_);
            }
            head = 0;
        }
        qq[head + cnt++] = v;
        iq[v] = true;
    }

    int dequeue() {
        int u = qq[head++];
        cnt--;
        iq[u] = false;
        return u;
    }

    bool spfa(int s, int t) {
        fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        head = cnt = 0;
        enqueue(s);
        while (cnt > 0) {
            int u = dequeue();
            int d = dd[u] + 1;
            for (int h_ : aa_[u])
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost[h] : -cost[h]);
                    int v = u ^ uv[h];
                    if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && dd[v] > d)) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        dd[v] = d;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        enqueue(v);
                    }
                }
        }
        return pi[t] != INF;
    }

    void push(int s, int t) {
        int c = INF;
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            c = min(c, cc[h_]);
        }
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            cc[h_] -= c;
            cc[h_ ^ 1] += c;
        }
    }

    void push1(int s, int t) {
        for (int u = t, h_, h; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        while (spfa(s, t))
            push1(s, t);
        int c = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1];
        return c;
    }

    void main() {
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        vector<int> ii(k);
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            cin >> ii[h], ii[h]--;

        vector<vector<int>> aa(n);
        for (int h = 0; h < m; h++) {
            int i, j;
            cin >> i >> j;
            i--; j--;
            aa[i].push_back(j);
            aa[j].push_back(i);
        }

        int t = n + k + 1;
        n_ = n * t + 1;
        m_ = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (t - 1);
        init(n_, m_, k);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : aa[i]) {
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++)
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s, v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }

        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++)
            link(n_ - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);

        cout << edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.main();
    return 0;
}
